build_pixel_decoder: build a PixelDecoder FPN-style module to decode multi-level feature maps into mask features
build_transformer_pixel_decoder: build a TransformerEncoderPixelDecoder that adds a transformer encoder to the FPN pixel decoder
test_PixelDecoder_forward: test the PixelDecoder forward pass with multi-scale feature maps and image metadata
test_TransformerEncoderPixelDecoder_forw: test the TransformerEncoderPixelDecoder forward pass with padding mask and positional encoding
review_PixelDecoder_init_weights: review the PixelDecoder init_weights method to verify caffe2_xavier initialization for all conv layers
